# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest release | Yes |
| Older releases | No - update to the newest build |

Security fixes ship in the latest release on [Releases](https://github.com/Josheyerr/slowed-reverb-desktop/releases).

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report privately through GitHub:

1. Open **Security** -> **Report a vulnerability** on this repo  
   https://github.com/Josheyerr/slowed-reverb-desktop/security/advisories/new
2. Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and impact if known

You will usually get a reply within about a week. If confirmed, a fix goes out in a normal release when ready.

### Scope

- **In scope:** the desktop app, installer, auto-update flow, and this repo's release process
- **Out of scope:** third-party tools we call ([FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/), [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp), [ssstik.io](https://ssstik.io/)) - report those upstream
